name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 10 Nov
state: The UK Government's Be Ready site states on 10 Nov that the national threat level is Severe, meaning a terrorist attack is highly likely. Counter Terrorism Policing announced the rise from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026, and the Security Minister later cited a growing threat from individuals and small groups in the UK. Searches on 10 Nov found no change to the level.
for_you: Follow MI5 and Counter Terrorism Policing guidance: stay alert in crowded places and report suspicious activity to police or the anti-terrorism hotline; call 999 in an emergency.
rubric_hit: National threat level Severe (Alert: Severe or Critical)
